entry.title: Show HN: Custom SQLites for agents (a remote MCP) (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: What if your agents could create (almost) any SQLite database they need? I built databasedmcp to let Claude (or any other agent) create databases for my sessions, in both Claude and Claude Code. With the MCP, agents can create multiple databases with basically any schema. Docs and tool descriptions: https://databasedmcp.com/docs Some use cases that I've discovered: * Share data between agents Let agents store their status, what they're working on, etc. This is essentially about passing data between coding agents. E.g. set up a worker agent that picks up work items that other agents add to the database. This kind of enables autonomous work discovery. * Build custom apps I've built many ad-hoc apps just by describing the idea to Claude. Ask it to create the UI as an artifact and to use databasedmcp as the backend. Artifacts can call MCP tools however they want. You use the chat to modify the app, and use the app itself in the artifact UI. Pretty easy to build small apps such as a shopping list, an expense tracker, etc. Then use Claude to extract data from documents, and store the data with databasedmcp in a structured manner. Any comments are appreciated, thanks! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50593621 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

Been unemployed for 2y and can't find a job, within those 2 years, I pretty much spent my savings that I've saved through years, maybe have 4-5 months left to support my household. Currently, I tutor math and probably about to start working as manager in pizzaria. In Jan 2025, I quit from a mid-size insurance tech company(1000+) after working there for almost 4y, because I was tipped off the they were about to start layoffs and they did. Well, since then I have zero luck finding any job in SWE. At this point, I have massive gap in my resume that I can't explain to recruiters, I can still code (C#/.NET/AWS) and learned the AI, but who cares if date of my last employment is Jan2025.
